curriculum.title: Analytics Capstone
points: This capstone project involves advanced data analysis skills through corporate dataset exploration: data acquisition, transformation, exploratory analysis with statistics and visualization, predictive modeling using supervised learning, prescriptive analytics for strategy, and data storytelling for compelling narratives.

curriculum.title: Digital Business Models and Value Proposition
Digital Transformation Capstone
points: In this capstone project, you'll develop a Digital Transformation Roadmap for an organization. You'll assess digital readiness, identify gaps, and benchmark against industry standards. The project includes creating transformation strategies, designing governance structures, identifying digital skills, proposing training programs, and fostering a digital-first culture. You will build a comprehensive roadmap with actionable recommendations and a framework to support ongoing digital transformation efforts.

content.title: Do I need to know Programming & Math before enrolling to a program?
content: Background in Programming & Maths is helpful but not mandatory.

content.title: What is the minimum system configuration required?
content: Any latest processor (i3/i5/i7) with 2.0GHz clock speed and RAM 4GB (required), 8GB(recommended).

content.title: How many projects can I anticipate working on?
content: In Executive Program in Analytics & Digital Transformation you will have access to case studies and Capstone Projects to provide a better understanding of the real-world applications of digital transformation concepts.

content.title: What all topics are covered in the Executive Program in Analytics & Digital Transformation?
How much time does one need to spend on a regular basis?
content: Ideally, 30 minutes of preparation time is recommended each day, but students can allocate time according to their own schedules. They can choose to practice, read, or watch videos. Additionally, students must attend live classes on weekends. The schedule for these classes will be shared in advance.

content.title: What is the duration of the program?
content: Every term is approximately 4-5 weeks long. The overall duration of the Executive Program in Analytics & Digital Transformation is 12 months.

content.title: How's the Executive Program in Analytics & Digital Transformation different?
content: ## This program is distinguished by three key elements:

- **Iterative Mastery Approach:** IITG's exclusive Iterative Mastery Approach ensures development through a step-by-step methodology, specifically designed to welcome individuals from diverse backgrounds. Whether you're seeking a lateral move in the industry or looking to broaden your skills, our program is tailored to empower you on your unique learning journey.

- **Versatile Skill Development Model:** IITG's unique framework ensures that every Digital Transformation concept is taught in the context of real-world industry problems. Our program goes beyond theory, emphasizing practical case studies to prepare students for the challenges they'll face in the professional arena.
- **Accredian Career Center:** Aligned with our mission to cultivate the leaders of tomorrow, the Accredian Career Center empowers you to confidently launch your career.

content.title: Tell me more about Career Assistance?
content: Accredian provides career assistance through the Career Launchpad program. Students gain hands-on experience as leaders in their chosen field with rigorous resume and portfolio building sessions. The program also covers creating a strong online presence and developing top-notch interview skills.
